title: scJDO2: label-free flow operators of single-cell dynamics from sampled time courses
description: scJDO2 estimates per-cell local operators from single-cell data. scjdo2.flow fits a flow operator (the Jacobian of a drift fitted to an entropic optimal-transport velocity) from a sampled time course in one call, and returns per-cell spectral descriptors. Release archived for the Bioinformatics Application Note and the scJDO bioRxiv preprint (v57).
